# Source: OpenAI Agents Python SDK Docs

- Upstream: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python
- Docs site: https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/
- License: MIT, copied in `LICENSE`
- Retrieved: 2026-05-14

## Included Files

- `agents.md`: agent construction and multi-agent behavior, including agents as
  tools.
- `tools.md`: hosted tools, FileSearchTool, function tools, and agents as tools.
- `sessions-index.md`: SDK sessions and conversation memory.

These files are included because they describe the native SDK features currently
being operationalized in Keystone.
